key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: Gradual over days. LOCATION: Focal or diffuse lung areas. DURATION: Days to weeks. CHARACTER: Productive cough, chest pain, dyspnea. AGGRAVATING: Lying flat, exertion. RELIEVING: Antibiotics, oxygen, positioning. TIMING: Acute, persistent. SEVERITY: Moderate to severe (6-8/10). ASSOCIATED SYMPTOMS: High fever, productive cough, chest pain, dyspnea, fatigue, malaise. KEY POSITIVES: High fever, productive cough, chest pain, dyspnea. KEY NEGATIVES: No wheezing (unless reactive airway disease).
